metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Alf Bellrule
records.biography_en: In The School Keeps Running, Alf Bellrule takes the role of school principal. “I can hear every corridor.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one small brass handbell and a slim folder held to the side.

records.name: Cobb Keyring
records.biography_en: In The School Keeps Running, Cobb Keyring takes the role of caretaker. “That's the door that sticks.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short oversized keyring with three visibly different keys.

records.name: Mara Floorloop
records.biography_en: In The School Keeps Running, Mara Floorloop takes the role of school cleaner. “The clean part starts here.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small hand mop with a short handle and little bright bucket at flank.

records.name: Faye Ladleline
records.biography_en: In The School Keeps Running, Faye Ladleline takes the role of school cook. “One more scoop for the quiet table.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: stubby ladle and a small food bowl.

records.name: Len Crosswatch
records.biography_en: In The School Keeps Running, Len Crosswatch takes the role of school crossing guard. “Wait for the gap.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one short crossing paddle with simple white stripes and a slim reflective sash.

records.name: Ned Stampnote
records.biography_en: In The School Keeps Running, Ned Stampnote takes the role of school office clerk. “That came in after the bell.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small wooden date stamp with blank base and two cream slips.
